title: Review Findings (Gold)
description: The Reviewer's output: advisory findings over a set of evaluation units. Advisory only — findings never block a merge and never override a deterministic gate (Sonar is federal; the Reviewer is state). Humans approve; deterministic gates block.

status.description: clean = no findings; findings = advisory findings present; stalled = a round resolved no fingerprints; gave_up = Governor limit hit.

advisory.description: Always true. The Reviewer advises; it never blocks or overrides a gate.

fingerprint.description: Stable id so repeat rounds can tell resolved from persisting findings.
